title: RBX Context Budget Policy
description: Declares the token allocation policy for a session. Enforces that model calls stay within ceiling_ratio of the model's context window, leaving margin for the model's response, tool calls, and retries. Default ceiling: 70%.

policy_id.description: Unique identifier for this budget policy (ULID or name).

total_window_tokens.description: Declared context window of the model being used for this session (in tokens).

ceiling_ratio.description: Maximum fraction of total_window_tokens that may be used for input. Default 0.7 (70%). Remainder is reserved for model response, tool calls, retries. Exceeding this emits context.budget.exceeded and halts the step.

tokenizer_hint.description: Tokenizer approximation to use for budget estimation. char_div_4 is the default approximation (characters / 4). Future versions will integrate provider-specific tokenizers.

slot_allocations.description: Per-slot token allocations as a fraction of (ceiling_ratio * total_window_tokens). Values must sum to <= 1.0. Unspecified slots share the remainder.

tool_definitions.description: Tool definitions for tools available in this step. Drop unused tools to reduce this slot.

governance_instructions.description: Governance rules and domain contract constraints (never compressed).

conversation_history.description: Prior conversation turns. Truncate oldest-first if over limit.

selected_files.description: Source files, ADRs, or documents selected for this step. Summarize if over limit.

tool_outputs.description: Results from prior tool calls. Truncate verbose outputs.

logs.description: Log output passed as context. Hard limit — never exceed.

diffs.description: Code or document diffs. Split across calls if over limit.

plans.description: Execution plans and step summaries. Compress to step summaries if over limit.

summaries.description: Compressed summaries from prior summarization sessions.

test_outputs.description: Test run results. Truncate to failures and first N lines of output.

overflow_policy.description: What to do when assembled context exceeds ceiling_ratio after compression. compress_and_emit_event is the default: apply compression, emit context.budget.compression_applied, continue. halt_and_escalate: stop the step and escalate.

justification_override_allowed.description: If true, a step may exceed ceiling_ratio when a logged justification event is emitted. Requires context.budget.exceeded to include a reason field. Use only for exceptional cases.

max_ratio.description: Maximum fraction of the ceiling budget this slot may use.

compressible.description: Whether this slot's content may be compressed or truncated when over budget.

priority.description: Compression priority (higher = compressed last). system_prompt and governance_instructions should be 10 (never compressed).
